name: WONG CHI FUNG, BRIAN
self_introduction: I'm an AI/ML engineer with extensive production R&D experience building and deploying domain-specific AI systems. I'm skilled in training and fine-tuning large models, developing LLM/RAG applications, model serving, and full-stack delivery. My title areas are AI/ML Engineer, LLM Systems, and Applied AI R&D.
working_background:
AI Research Engineer at LifeCode (Oct 2021 – Oct 2025): I built a sequence-level binding-affinity predictor with LLM encoders, reducing research prediction turnaround from weeks to days. I developed toxicity-screening ensembles with XGBoost, CatBoost, Random Forest, and LightGBM to filter high-risk drug candidates before lab work. I delivered FastAPI/Docker inference services with logging, metrics, and health monitoring, and I contributed to the development and deployment of PetaPoly™ 4.0, an AI-driven drug discovery platform supporting internal research workflows.

Frontend Developer at theOrigo (Mar 2019 – Feb 2021): I built responsive production web applications for government, education, healthcare, arts, and enterprise clients. I delivered public-facing websites and digital platforms for 1823, EdUHK, Hong Kong Philharmonic, CUHK Medical Clinic, and CUHK Medical Centre. I worked with designers, backend engineers, and stakeholders, resolved production issues, and supported reliable releases.

Research Assistant at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Aug 2017 – Jun 2018): I conducted plant-genomics research using DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, and ChIP-seq under rigorous laboratory protocols.
education:
MSc, Information Technology (Distinction), Hong Kong Polytechnic University, 2024–2026. MSc, Genomics & Bioinformatics, Chinese University of Hong Kong, 2016–2017. BSc, Biochemistry & Cell Biology, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, 2012–2016.

Training: Data Science & Machine Learning Immersive, Xccelerate, Mar 2021 – Jun 2021. Software Engineering Immersive, Xccelerate, Jul 2018 – Feb 2019.

LLM & Retrieval: OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, FAISS, pgvector, BM25, hybrid retrieval, evaluation.

highlighted_project:
Multimodal Chatbot (github.com/brian546/QA_bot) — FastAPI, Streamlit, LangGraph, RAG, Ollama: I built a grounded multi-document QA system supporting PDF, TXT, PPTX, XLSX, and images. It uses BM25 plus semantic retrieval with reciprocal-rank fusion, cited answers, chat history, and session management.

Cross-Lingual LawRAG (github.com/brian546/lawRAG) — LangGraph, RAG, Transformers, MLflow: I built an English-to-German legal RAG agent with multilingual bi-encoder retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, exact-citation prediction, and Macro-F1, Precision@k, and Recall@k evaluation.
